label: sparse late-copy-phase update unit in long sequences (no clean trigger)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never during original or delimiter steps), almost entirely in long sequences (L=9 holds 72% of mass, L=8 20%), and becomes more frequent as recall_idx rises (17.5x lift at recall_idx 8). It never fires on the first occurrence of an input token (in_first=1 has zero activations). Within that region it is very sparse (about 1% of late copy steps). It is enriched for inputs 0, r, b, d and outputs j, i, 0, b, h, but none of the token combinations I tried gave precision above about 13%. The best F1 on dev was 0.16. Magnitudes are tiny (max 0.008), and the largest values come at mid-to-late copy steps of L=9 sequences. The recorded predicate (phase==2 and L>=8) covers about 93% of activation mass but has about 1% precision, so it only says where the unit lives, not what triggers it.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: 0, r, b, d, p, c; least: s, l, w, q) and the previous input (most: i, 0, m, r, j, b; least: s, n, v, q); timing cues that raise it most: L=3 & t=5, t=17, recall_idx=8.
